_meta.source: Google Business Profile: Triple SR Cleaning Services Pty Ltd
notes: Text is verbatim from Google (typos and punctuation unchanged). Do not edit.
'postedRelative' is as shown on 2026-11-04; use Google's own relative wording or drop dates, do not invent exact dates.
Selected: 15 five-star reviews, ordered by relevance to a commercial site. Star count inferred from the 'Highest rating' sort order and, for Shahriare Parvez, an explicit 5-star display.
Most reviews are from residential, apartment or end-of-lease jobs. Only the first two mention offices. Show the Google attribution and do not label residential reviews as hospital/school/etc. work.
Never display a 5.0 aggregate; the verified aggregate is 4.6 from 36 reviews.

reviews.name: sarah berle
reviews.text: The team did an incredible job when my office needed cleaning. They were all lovely and communicated very clearly with me. I would definitely book them again!

reviews.name: George F
reviews.text: Brian regularly cleans my office space on a weekly basis. Happy with service & quality of clean

reviews.name: Shahriare Parvez
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic service from Triple SR Cleaning! The team was professional, friendly, punctual, and paid great attention to detail. They did an excellent job and left everything looking spotless and fresh.

I’m genuinely impressed with the quality of their work and the customer service. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable and professional cleaning service. I would definitely use Triple SR Cleaning again! 👌

reviews.name: Reet Kaur
reviews.text: I recently used triple sr cleaning for my end-of-lease clean, and they were absolutely fantastic. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and left the place spotless — even the oven and windows looked brand new! The real estate agent was very impressed and I got my full bond back without any issues. Great value for money and very professional service. Highly recommended for anyone moving out!

reviews.name: Vishanth
reviews.text:
Absolutely Exceptional Service!
I recently had the pleasure of working with Triple SR Services, and I can confidently say they exceeded all expectations. From start to finish, the team was professional, reliable, and incredibly efficient. Their attention to detail and commitment to quality really stood out — nothing was too much trouble, and every request was handled with care and precision.

reviews.name: Brennen Brixen
reviews.text: Fantastic service provided, extremely punctual and efficient. Got the job done twice as fast and twice as cheap as the other companies out there.

reviews.name: Haren Jayasinghe
reviews.text: Brayan and his team did an amazing job! They were punctual, finished the job on time and did an exceptional job cleaning the kitchen and bathrooms, which were my main priorities. The price was reasonable and the overall service was excellent. Highly recommend them!

reviews.name: Sérgio Dias
reviews.text: Very efficient and incredible work, from general cleaning, to carpet, to blinds and appliances. The team was very nice and even adjusted their schedule to accomodate my time constraints.

reviews.name: Allan Magaoay
reviews.text: Triple SR Cleaning Service did an marvelous job, they were punctual on time, friendly and also felt safe to leave the property in their hands and in the end we got it back brand new spick and span - Strongly recommended❤️

reviews.name: Gerico Ramos
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic cleaning service! They did an excellent job and left everything spotless. Very professional, thorough, and friendly. I’m extremely happy with the results and would highly recommend their service to anyone looking for a reliable and high-quality cleaner.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you so much for the appreciation.

reviews.name: GJ Kiruba
reviews.text: Highly recommended Triple SR Cleaning Services. Very good service and communication.

reviews.name: Basem Ibrahim
reviews.text: Got a team of cleaners over to make the house spotless and shiny - did a great job, would definitely use again - highly recommend!
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you. You are the best customer.

reviews.name: anoushka towler
reviews.text: Amazing service Brian is Fantastic! I did my end of tenancy clean, Thank you so much

reviews.name: Vimeth Jayawickrama
reviews.text:
I recently hired Triple SR Cleaning to clean my apartment, and I’m extremely happy with the results. The team was very professional, punctual, and paid great attention to detail. They left the entire apartment spotless from the floors to the kitchen and bathroom everything looked fresh and perfectly cleaned.

What impressed me the most was how thorough they were and how friendly the cleaners were throughout the process. You can really tell they care about doing a high-quality job.

I would highly recommend Triple SR Cleaning to anyone looking for reliable and professional cleaning services. I will definitely be using them again!

reviews.name: Shivir Pokharel
reviews.text: Very good service and very professional and courteous
